articles.title: 'Smashed head': Father, brother kill woman over viral video with male friend
articles.description: A disturbing case emerged where a woman was allegedly murdered by her father and brother in a supposed act of family honour. The crime was triggered by a viral video showcasing her with a male acquaintance. To conceal their heinous act, the accused staged it as a road accident, brutally attacking her with a hammer in a remote area. The police have now initiated a murder case against the perpetrators.

Million-dollar question: OpenAI claims to have an answer to 90-year old maths problem
articles.description: OpenAI has revealed that its advanced AI model has found a solution to a complex math problem that has persisted for 90 years. This monumental task in fluid dynamics was accomplished in just 88 hours, employing nearly ten thousand AI agents during the process. Nevertheless, the achievement is pending validation by independent mathematicians, with OpenAI emphasizing that their intention was to highlight AI advancements rather than pursue any monetary rewards.

articles.title: Toxic air after 9/11: Mamdani releases documents showing how New Yorkers were misled
articles.description: In a significant move, New York City disclosed withheld documents on air quality after 9/11, suggesting that officials may have misrepresented the dangers present post-collapse of the Twin Towers. A memo warned of potential lawsuits for toxic exposure and city liability concerns. There were also fears about asbestos levels and negative public response. This revelation follows a legal challenge from the advocacy group 9/11 Health Watch.

articles.title: Roman cemetery dig reveals Stone Age man buried with 2 skulls, 42 teeth and an axe
articles.description: In a startling archaeological find, researchers uncovered a burial site dating back to the Stone Age, predating nearby Roman graves by thousands of years. The grave contained a battle axe, striking amber beads, and a unique necklace fashioned from the teeth of 42 animals. Additionally, two human skulls were discovered alongside the skeleton, offering rare insights into the rituals and practices of ancient communities.

articles.title: Rupee slips to 94.95 as crude nears $100 amid intensifying US-Iran tensions
articles.description: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee faced a decline against the US dollar, influenced by rising crude oil prices and growing tensions between the US and Iran. Although a slip in the dollar provided some cushion for the rupee, domestic stock markets suffered losses, with both the Sensex and Nifty falling. Investors are now awaiting inflation data releases from the US and India.

articles.description: On Tuesday, Indian stock markets faced a notable decline, with the Sensex falling by 555 points to close at 75,577. The rupee settled at 94.83 per dollar, signaling a strong risk-averse attitude among investors.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Selena's LA mansion SOLD for USD 5.4 Mn: PICS
articles.description: Selena Gomez has sold her Encino mansion for USD 5.4 million. This property was purchased in 2020 from Tom Petty's estate. Gomez also bought a Beverly Hills home with Benny Blanco for USD 35 million.

articles.title: ‘James Bond’ screenwriter Steven Knight talks about working on the film’s script
articles.description: Screenwriter Steven Knight shared that crafting the new James Bond script has been a more fluid experience with an actor already chosen. He emphasized the importance of developing the character rather than focusing solely on the actor. As a proud British writer, Knight feels a strong responsibility in contributing to this legendary franchise. The upcoming 007 will take the baton from Daniel Craig, who dazzled audiences in five iconic films.

articles.title: Rajkiran moves Madras HC over producer’s complaint
articles.description: In a recent legal maneuver, veteran actor Rajkiran sought anticipatory bail from the Madras High Court against allegations from a producer regarding an unpaid film advance of Rs 40 lakh. Rajkiran contends that the matter is civil, emphasizing he has already returned part of the advance after consultations with the Producers' Council. The court's ruling will shape the future of this ongoing situation.

articles.title: Did 'Dorothy' composer Ilaiyaraaja insult Karthik Subbaraj?
articles.description: Music composer Ilaiyaraaja has stirred up conversations among fans with his recent comments about new talent. He articulated his preference for collaborating with emerging filmmakers like Karthik Subbaraj, describing them as 'empty vessels.' This sparked a mixed response, with some fans labeling his remarks as arrogant while others offered their admiration. The soundtrack for the upcoming film 'Dorothy' showcases Ilaiyaraaja's work, curated under Subbaraj's direction.
